_doc: R82 — The Breakout. A rival lab that keeps losing to you starts losing other things: specimens. Each escapee is a REAL rival chimera, built by campaign/rivals.js's own generator from that lab's parts at that lab's grades, so a loose one is indistinguishable from one still on the ladder — because it was on the ladder. Unlike a counter-offensive (regions.json contestation) an escapee has NO deadline: it accumulates on a standing board and waits, because the point of the system is more fights with rival anatomy, and a window that closes while the player is asleep produces fewer of them, not more. It is gated on `startsAfterDefeats` so nothing gets loose until you have actually rattled somebody. Beating one closes the entry either way; the Containment Cannon decides whether it goes home in a bay or is collected by its old lab, and a bagged one reaches the roster the same way every captive does — the Reorientation Wing (campaign/rehab.js). maxLoose caps the board so a player who ignores it does not return to a wall of them.
blurb: Somebody else's science, unsupervised, in a county that is nominally yours.
intel: Loose specimen — {lab} built it, {lab} lost it, and it has been eating well since. Bag it and the Wing can talk it round.
sightings: on the roof of the feed store
in a parked school bus, which it now owns
at the county fairground, judging livestock
